name: config
prompt:
Explain what this Renyi program does in at most three sentences, for a reader who will decide whether to use it. Do not quote code.

module config
  purpose: Load and validate the service configuration.

import std.filesystem exposing Path
import std.json

public type Port is Integer where value is at least 1 and value is at most 65535
  purpose: A TCP port number.

public type LogLevel is one of
  purpose: How much the service writes to its log.
  Quiet
  Normal
  Verbose
end

public type Config
  purpose: Everything the service needs in order to start.
  has port: Port
  has workers: Integer where workers is at least 1 and workers is at most 64
  has log_level: LogLevel
  can FromJson
end

public type ConfigError is one of
  purpose: Why the configuration could not be loaded.
  Unreadable(path: Path)
  Invalid(detail: Text)
end

public function load(path: Path) returns Config or fails with ConfigError needs filesystem.read
  purpose: Read the JSON configuration file and check every constraint.
  see also: default_config, load_with_fallback

  let text be filesystem.read_text(path) otherwise fail with Unreadable(path: path)
  let config: Config be json.parse(text)
    otherwise fail with Invalid(detail: "the file does not match the Config shape")
  return config
end

public function default_config() returns Config
  purpose: The configuration used when no file is present.
  example: default_config().port is Port(8080)

  return Config(port: Port(8080), workers: 4, log_level: Normal)
end

public function load_or_default(path: Path) returns Config needs filesystem.read
  purpose: Load the file, falling back to the defaults when it cannot be loaded.
  deprecated: since 0.2, replaced by load_with_fallback

  return load(path) otherwise default_config()
end

public function load_with_fallback(path: Path, fallback: Config)
  returns Config
  needs filesystem.read
  purpose: Load the file, falling back to the given configuration when it cannot be loaded.

  return load(path) otherwise fallback
end
